query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM sandbox_instances s JOIN conversations c ON c.id = s.conversation_id WHERE c.owner_id = (SELECT owner_id FROM conversations WHERE id = $1) AND s.conversation_id IS DISTINCT FROM $2) < $3 AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM conversations c JOIN templates t ON t.name = c.template WHERE c.id = $1 AND 'desktop' = ANY(t.capabilities)) OR (SELECT count(*) FROM sandbox_instances s JOIN conversations c ON c.id = s.conversation_id JOIN templates t ON t.name = c.template WHERE 'desktop' = ANY(t.capabilities) AND s.conversation_id IS DISTINCT FROM $2) < $4) AS "admits!"
